# WOGO Cocktail Walk

> WOGO Cocktail Walk is a self-guided cocktail walk in the Netherlands: one ticket gives you a reserved spot and one cocktail (or mocktail) at each of three hand-picked bars in one evening, with a digital route map. There is no guide and no group: you walk at your own pace with your own company.

Tagline: Explore your city, one cocktail at a time.

## Key facts

- What it is: a self-guided cocktail walk (bar crawl with reserved spots) past 3 bars, 3 drinks included.
- Cities: Amsterdam, Rotterdam (3 routes), Delft, Groningen and Utrecht. 7 routes in 5 cities, all in the Netherlands.
- Price: from €29,95 per person. Rotterdam Route 3 Premium is €34,95 per person.
- Included: a reserved spot at each of 3 bars, 3 drinks (at every bar you choose one of two signature WOGO cocktails or the mocktail) and a digital Cocktail Walk Map. No app needed.
- Duration: most guests take 3 to 4 relaxed hours. Only the start time at the first bar is fixed.
- Walking: 5 to 15 minutes between stops.
- Alcohol-free: every route can be done fully with mocktails.
- Age: 18+ to drink alcohol (Dutch law). Under-18s are welcome on the mocktail version when accompanied by an adult, by arrangement.
- The bars on a route are revealed in the route map after booking.
- Groups, birthdays, bachelorette parties and company outings: via the group bookings page.

## Groups and occasions

- One page for every group: https://www.wogococktailwalk.com/groups/ (Dutch: https://www.wogococktailwalk.com/nl/groups/).
- Up to 6 people book online straight away on the city or route page. Groups of 7 to 30 send a group request; the team replies with a proposal.
- Group price: from €32,95 per person. Spots are reserved for the whole group at all 3 bars.
- Popular occasions: bachelorette and hen parties, birthdays, company outings and team drinks, friends' nights out, graduations.
- Date night: a WOGO walk for two is booked online on any city page; no group request needed.
- In the group request you can give a budget per person and ask for extras such as an extra stop, dinner or snacks.
- Groups walk in every WOGO city: Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Delft, Groningen and Utrecht.
- Gift cards: available online, valid for any city.
- Changing a booking: contact info@wogoamsterdam.com and the team will see what is possible.
- Booking: online at www.wogococktailwalk.com, payment by iDEAL or card.
- Guests so far: 100,000+. Rated 4.4 on Google and 4.2 on Trustpilot. Partner of Gemeente Rotterdam.
- Utrecht is currently fully booked; there is a waiting list on the Utrecht page.
